parts.text:
You and Dirk fly through the NewVision office front door before piling into Dirk's company car.

'Driver, to the Jane Levitt show!' Dirk barks before letting out an ungodly snort.

'How far is it to the studio? And how long do you think the interveiw will take?' You ask.

'Buddy! Pal! There's no rush- drink it all in, it's not often a face like yours gets on prime time!

Only joking, kid: it's about a half an hour until we're there, and then the interveiw shouldn't be more than ten minutes.'

You nod sheepishly.
As the pine trees pass by, you can't help but remember your promise to be there on your son's birthday.
As the pine trees pass by, you can't help but feel nervous.
